what: On hover the pill button’s plate swells to 1.05 wide and 1.1 tall, two copies of the text roll up one line (100%) so the second copy settles in place, and the whole text box shifts 1.8em to the right. The right arrow exits to the upper right (130%, −130%), and a hidden arrow enters from the lower left into the freed spot on the left and settles. All at .4s cubic-bezier(.16,.5,.25,1). With look: link there is no plate, just a text link, and the shift is 1em + 4px.

options.--fx-shift: Distance the text column is pushed, default 1.8em (arrow column + gap)
options.--fx-gap: Gap between text and arrow, default .8em
options.look: link — Text link without a panel
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text box — contains label and label-copy
options.[data-fx-part=icon-copy]: Same arrow slot entering from the left

use: ExploreExplore
